name: Toriko
source:
Our protagonist is a new teacher with a notion of love and lust. He imprisons his student Yumiko Saeki at the request of Asami Tamura who enslaved her and took her virginity. During the summer vacations fierce and dense training begins.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角是一位有着爱与情欲观念的新老师。他应奴役她并夺走她童贞的田村麻美的要求，监禁了他的学生佐伯由美子。暑假期间，激烈而密集的训练开始了。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
